card.statement:
Let $\mu\in X_{*}(T)$. Then

$\overline{S_{\mu}}=\bigsqcup_{\nu\leq\mu}S_{\nu}.$

Moreover, there exists a $\mathbf{C}$ -vector space $V$ and a closed embedding $\Psi:\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\mu+Q^{\vee}}\to\mathbf{P}(V)$ such that the boundary of $S_{\mu}$ is the set-theoretic intersection of $\overline{S_{\mu}}$ with a hyperplane $H_{\mu}$ of $\mathbf{P}(V)$:

$\partial S_{\mu}=\overline{S_{\mu}}\cap\Psi^{-1}(H_{\mu}).$
card.label: Proposition 3.4

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
